whyThisMatters:
Browser-based tool that packages, deploys and auto-updates apps into Microsoft Intune with one click, for IT admins and MSPs. Founder Thomas (ex-MSP/Intune consultant). Started at 25 dollars a month; current tiers 49 dollars a month (≤100 devices), 99 dollars a month (MSP multi-tenant), 149 dollars a month (larger fleets + custom apps). Built on Bubble + GitHub Actions + Azure.

Packaging one Windows app for Intune can take an hour by hand. This is legacy-enterprise glue for IT admins — the Conductor pattern exactly: small, deep, compliance-minded buyers with very low churn.

An IT admin has to wrap a Windows app so Intune will install it and keep it updated. By hand, that can take an hour. This does the wrap in the browser. The plans step up with the number of devices, and there is one for a shop that manages many clients. The founder used to do this work as a consultant. The monthly number is his, from a 2026 interview, not a Stripe connection.
